config.script:
import re
	
	# ------------------------------
	# 1️⃣ Get all usernames
	# ------------------------------
	users = system.user.getUsers('default')
	usernames = []
	
	for user in users:
	    s = str(user)
	    match = re.search(r'username=([^,]+)', s)
	    if match:
	        usernames.append(match.group(1))
	
	print("Usernames:", usernames)
	
	# ------------------------------
	# 2️⃣ Ensure folder exists
	# ------------------------------
	folderPath = "[RCSD]Users_Theme"
	
	# Browse the folder path to check if it exists
	try:
	    system.tag.browse(folderPath)
	    folderExists = True
	except:
	    folderExists = False
	
	if not folderExists:
	    # Create the folder under [RCSD]
	    system.tag.addTag(parentPath="[RCSD]", tag={
	        "name": "Users_Theme",
	        "tagType": "Folder",
	        "enabled": True
	    })
	    print("Created folder [RCSD]Users_Theme")
	
	# ------------------------------
	# 3️⃣ Get existing tags under the folder
	# ------------------------------
	results = system.tag.browse(folderPath)
	tagNames = [str(i['name']) for i in results.getResults()]
	
	print("Existing tag names:", tagNames)
	
	# ------------------------------
	# 4️⃣ Compare and find missing usernames
	# ------------------------------
	missingUsernames = [u for u in usernames if u not in tagNames]
	
	# Print missing usernames as comma-separated string
	print("Missing usernames:", ", ".join(missingUsernames))
	
	# ------------------------------
	# 5️⃣ Create missing tags (one per username)
	# ------------------------------
	for name in missingUsernames:
	    newTag = {
	        "name": name,          # Tag name = username
	        "tagType": "AtomicTag",   # Correct tag type
	        "dataType": "String",  # String type
	        "value": "",           # Default empty value
	        "enabled": True
	    }
	    # Use configure to add the tag
	    system.tag.configure(basePath=folderPath, tags=[newTag])
	    print("Created tag:", name)
	
	print("✅ Done creating missing tags.")
	
	# ------------------------------
	# 6️⃣ Apply theme for logged-in user
	# ------------------------------
	username = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
	
	if not username:
	    self.session.props.theme = "light"
	    return
	
	tagPath = folderPath + "/" + username
	result = system.tag.readBlocking([tagPath])[0]
	
	if result.quality.isGood() and result.value:
	    self.session.props.theme = result.value
	else:
	    self.session.props.theme = "light"

system.perspective.alterDock('navMain',{'size':150})
